target.title: fix(nodes): resolve Unicode browser node names when configured by display name
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
Browser gateway requests could fail to select a browser-capable node by display name when the node name used non-ASCII letters or numbers. The Browser gateway had its own ASCII-only matcher, while sibling node-selection flows use the shared resolver.

## Why This Change Was Made
The shared node-name normalizer now preserves Unicode letters and numbers while still treating punctuation-only queries as unknown. Browser gateway node selection now goes through the shared resolver, and the shared resolver preserves the shipped compact selector form as a lower-priority display-name match so persisted selectors such as `MacStudio` still match `Mac Studio` without outranking exact display-name matches.

## User Impact
Users can target browser nodes by Unicode display names without needing to copy a node id or IP address. Existing configured browser node selectors that omit spaces or punctuation continue to resolve after the gateway switches to the shared matcher.

## Evidence
- Claim proved at `c62de0bfb56de1df8338d12c946f11d43346cc1f`: Unicode display names are preserved, punctuation-only queries stay unknown, compact display-name selectors still resolve below exact display-name matches, and `browser.request` routes a configured compact Unicode browser node selector through the node proxy.
- Focused tests: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/shared/node-match.test.ts extensions/browser/src/gateway/browser-request.profile-from-body.test.ts` passed with 2 Vitest shards, 21 tests passing.
- Browser gateway proof: `extensions/browser/src/gateway/browser-request.profile-from-body.test.ts` now exercises `browserHandlers["browser.request"]` with `gateway.nodes.browser.node = "Café01"`, connected display name `Café 01`, and observes `nodeRegistry.invoke` using `nodeId: "cafe-node"` with `command: "browser.proxy"`.
- Runtime resolver proof: `node --import tsx --input-type=module -` importing `src/agents/tools/nodes-utils.ts` resolved `resolveNodeIdFromList([{ nodeId: "cafe-node", displayName: "Café 01", caps: ["browser"], commands: ["browser.proxy"] }], "Café01", false)` to `cafe-node`.
- Diff hygiene: `git diff --check -- src/shared/node-match.ts src/shared/node-match.test.ts extensions/browser/src/gateway/browser-request.profile-from-body.test.ts` passed.
- Review proof: `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode commit --commit HEAD` passed with no accepted/actionable findings.
